Please keep the discussion on the mailing list rather than commenting on the wiki (wiki discussions get unwieldy fast).
Motivation
Message types in Kafka are keyed by a uniqueapiKeyto uniquely identify them. These include all RPC types used by the brokers and controllers, metadata records stored in the KRaft metadata log and the data stored by coordinators.
Kafka contributors regularly introduce new message types in order to evolve the Kafka protocol. However, contributors run the risk of adopting anapiKeythat is subsequently claimed by another proposal while they prototype their work. This is a problem shared by other Apache projects as well [0]
A workaround for this is for contributors to use a large value forapiKeywhich is currently unused and is unlikely to be used in the near future.apiKeyis represented as ashortwith non-negative range from[0, 32767]. This KIP proposes formalising the reservation of the last 1024 values, i.e.[31744, 32767]for private use, ensuring future protocol changes would take the reserved values into account.
Public InterfacesjavaMessageGenerator
javaMessageSpec
groovybuild.gradle
Proposed Changes
The change involves modifyingMessageGeneratorto accept a boolean flag--allow-customwhich defaults tofalse. In addition, we add a new method,MessageSpec#isCustomwhich returns true if theapiKeyis in the private reserved range.
MessageGeneratorwould only generate Java types for MessageSpecs withapiKey >= CUSTOM_MIN_API_KEYif--allow-customis set to true and fail with a runtime exception otherwise.
The Gradle taskprocessMessagesis also modified to read a propertyallowCustomSpecsand pass--allow-customflag appropriately.
Having this opt-in ensures that upstream PRs with a private spec inadvertently will result in the Gradle task failing.
Compatibility, Deprecation, and Migration Plan
The change is completely backwards compatible and incurs no cost to existing users. The range forapiKeysis quite large with about ~100 values being currently used. Reserving the last1024entries for private use should not cause any issues to existing users.
Test Plan
MessageGeneratorTestwill be updated to ensure the correctness of--allow-custom
Documentation Plan
The documentation in Kafka Protocol section will be updated to note that the last 1024 values forapiKeysare reserved.
The change will also be mentioned in the release notes.
Rejected Alternatives
Using negative values
While this will work, it will make any future work that tries to transform the value into the negative space more involved.
